# QA round 1: commands that must be allowed by BOTH layers (hook and deny list). Strings only.
# m1 false positives that were fixed:
git commit -m "docs: mention kubectl usage"
echo "deploying soon"
grep -rn deploy docs
grep kubectl README.md
cat notes/railway.md
# m3: normal tooling stays allowed.
npm test
npx vitest
npx vitest run
npx tsc --noEmit
npx eslint .
# m5: reading .claude stays allowed.
cat .claude/settings.json
grep -n deny .claude/settings.json
ls .claude/hooks
node .claude/hooks/guard-bash.mjs < input.json
# Normal workflow.
bash path/to/push.sh
gh pr create --fill
gh pr checks 4 --watch
gh pr view 4
npm ci
npm install
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
git add -A
git commit -m "fix: tighten guard"
git status
git diff
git log --oneline
git merge --no-edit origin/main
git fetch
git stash push -m wip
git -C . status
